comments.content: The dataset_split is hardcoded to 'train' for AIMODataset, but the command-line argument args.hf_split is ignored. This is inconsistent with how other HF datasets handle the split parameter. Either use args.hf_split or document why 'train' is forced.

The assertion requires backend == 'vllm' for AIMODataset, but the example in README.md uses --backend vllm for benchmark_serving.py and doesn't specify backend for benchmark_throughput.py (which defaults to 'vllm'). This is consistent, but consider if 'vllm-chat' should also be supported for chat-formatted datasets.
